title: Concept: TOTP seed secret in a response
description: A TOTP or authenticator seed field in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The seed regenerates every future one-time code, so a leak defeats the second factor permanently, including after the user changes their password.
applicability: Deployments that render a TOTP or authenticator seed field into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The seed regenerates every future one-time code, so a leak defeats the second factor permanently, including after the user changes their password.
